note: Re-judged 2026-11-15 after 22be149a08 changed processMessages: the only change is in the received-Notification branch with the fatal bit set, which now logs at INFO instead of WARN and returns errPeerFatalNotification wrapped with the status and the referred message type. The Initialization case's KeepAlive Time zero check (initMsg.KeepaliveTime == 0 -> rejectInit(statusSessionRejectedBadKeepaliveTime, msgHdr.MessageID, errBadKeepaliveTime)), handleInit and both tagged units are byte-identical, so the judgement stands. RFC 5036 Section 3.5.3, KeepAlive Time: "Two octet unsigned non zero integer that indicates the number of seconds that the sending LSR proposes for the value of the KeepAlive Time." Negative: KeepAlive Time 0 yields Session Rejected/Bad KeepAlive Time referring to message id 7 of type Initialization, errBadKeepaliveTime (isolates this check), non-operational state, non-zero hold and keepalive. Positive: a 30s proposal plus the peer's KeepAlive reaches operational with negotiated and armed KeepAlive 30s and no Notification within 200ms.
